Not In Pay::CT2.formula: IF(OR(CG2="0",CG2="9",CG2="A"),CONCATENATE("Joint-and-",CK2*100,"% Survivor ",IF(CP2=0,"Annuity", "with " & ROUND(CP2/12,0) & "-year Certain-and-Continuous Annuity"),IF(CG2="0"," with Pop-up","")),IF(CG2="5",CONCATENATE(ROUND(CP2/12,4),"-year Certain-and-Continuous Annuity"),"Straight Life Annuity"))

See the Benefit Calculation section for further details.",IF(EY2="N","Your current monthly benefit of $"&TEXT(AP2,"00.00")&" will not change.
